senses.en: to help or encourage a person, group, or idea

example.en: Her friends supported her during the difficult year.
example.zh: 在那艰难的一年里，朋友们支持了她。

senses.en: help or encouragement given to someone or something

example.en: The project received strong support from local businesses.
example.zh: 该项目得到了当地企业的大力支持。

senses.en: to hold something up or bear its weight

example.en: These columns support the roof of the hall.
example.zh: 这些柱子支撑着大厅的屋顶。

senses.en: a thing that holds something up

example.en: The bridge needs stronger supports under the deck.
example.zh: 这座桥的桥面下需要更坚固的支撑物。

senses.en: simple and not decorated or complicated
senses.zh: 简单的；朴素的；不事装饰的

example.en: She wore a plain white shirt.
example.zh: 她穿了一件朴素的白色衬衫。

senses.en: easy to see or understand; clear

example.en: It was plain that he was unhappy.

senses.en: a large area of flat land without trees

example.en: Wild horses roamed the open plain.
example.zh: 野马在开阔的平原上漫游。

senses.en: a software program designed for a particular purpose, especially one used on a phone or tablet
senses.zh: 应用程序（尤指手机或平板电脑上的软件）

example.en: I downloaded a new app to help me learn Chinese.
example.zh: 我下载了一个新应用程序来帮助我学中文。

example.en: It was so cold that the lake froze.
example.zh: 天气太冷了，湖面都结冰了。

example.en: She was tired, so she went to bed.

senses.en: in the way or state just mentioned, or referring to a statement as true
senses.zh: 这样；如此；（指前述情况）确实

senses.en: used in 'so that' to give a purpose or intended result
senses.zh: 用于 so that，表示目的：以便；为了

example.en: I wrote it down so that I would not forget.
example.zh: 我把它记了下来，以免忘记。

senses.en: one of the things you can choose to do or have

example.en: We have two options: take the train or drive.
example.zh: 我们有两个选择：坐火车或开车。

senses.en: the right to buy or sell something at a fixed price by a certain date

example.en: The company gave her stock options as part of her pay.
example.zh: 公司给了她股票期权作为薪酬的一部分。

senses.en: to obtain an agreement giving you the right to buy or use something later, especially film rights to a book
senses.zh: 取得日后购买或使用某物的选择权（尤指作品改编权）

example.en: A film studio optioned her novel last year.
example.zh: 一家电影制片厂去年取得了购买她小说改编权的选择权。

senses.en: a large cup with a handle, used for hot drinks

example.en: She poured coffee into a mug.
example.zh: 她把咖啡倒进一个马克杯里。

senses.en: to attack and rob someone in a public place

example.en: Two men mugged him outside the station.
example.zh: 两名男子在车站外袭击并抢劫了他。

example.en: He wiped a hand across his mug.

senses.en: to make silly faces, especially for a camera

example.en: The kids were mugging for the camera.
example.zh: 孩子们对着镜头做鬼脸。
